description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation class within the OrangeHRM reporting plugin. It manages filtering employee education data, including adding query constraints, retrieving entity aliases, and converting filter values to array representation.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: A class representing the employee education filter field used in reports, capable of adding filter conditions to queries and converting filter values.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query if the operator is 'EQUAL' and the filter value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, specifically ['education'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter value to an array containing 'id' and 'label' if the education entity is found.
